about: Pass 5.3 Lane A manual field-coverage entries (single-host engine objects). Skips cite the swagger / docs line; attr entries name a provider attribute fieldcov cannot see (client option names differ from the query/body names, or the body is assembled by the client).

engine:ContainerCreate/ArgsEscaped.skip: Windows-only flag (swagger.yaml:1420 'Command is already escaped (Windows only)') that the image builder records for shell-form Windows commands; docker run has no flag for it and the provider passes command / entrypoint as exec-form arrays, so there is nothing escaped

engine:ContainerCreate/AttachStderr.skip: the provider never attaches to a container's streams (no ContainerAttach call; swagger.yaml:1361-1400): a run's output is read afterwards with ContainerLogs (docker_container state = "exited", docker_container_run), so the attach flags would have no effect

engine:ContainerCreate/AttachStdin.skip: the provider never attaches to a container's streams (no ContainerAttach call; swagger.yaml:1361-1400): a run's output is read afterwards with ContainerLogs (docker_container state = "exited", docker_container_run), so the attach flags would have no effect

engine:ContainerCreate/AttachStdout.skip: the provider never attaches to a container's streams (no ContainerAttach call; swagger.yaml:1361-1400): a run's output is read afterwards with ContainerLogs (docker_container state = "exited", docker_container_run), so the attach flags would have no effect

engine:ContainerCreate/HostConfig/Contai.skip: client-side option: the docker CLI itself creates the --cidfile and writes the ID (docker-cli docs container_run.md:176-190, 'Docker closes this file when docker run exits'); the daemon only stores the path (swagger.yaml:1028); the container ID is the resource's id output

engine:ContainerCreate/NetworkingConfig/.skip: daemon-computed output (swagger.yaml:3451-3463; api/docs/CHANGELOG.md:421-423, v1.44): built from the container name, aliases, short ID and hostname; set it through networks.aliases, name and hostname

engine:ContainerCreate/OnBuild.skip: image build metadata (swagger.yaml:1461 'ONBUILD metadata that were defined in the image's Dockerfile'): it only affects a later build FROM a committed image, not the container, and docker run has no flag for it; commit-time config is docker_image_commit's (Lane R)

engine:ContainerCreate/StdinOnce.skip: closes stdin when an attached client disconnects (swagger.yaml:1397); the provider never attaches to a container's streams (no ContainerAttach call; swagger.yaml:1361-1400): a run's output is read afterwards with ContainerLogs (docker_container state = "exited", docker_container_run), so the attach flags would have no effect

engine:ContainerExec/DetachKeys.skip: detach key sequence only matters to an interactive client attached to a TTY that types it (swagger.yaml:8970-8976, 11244-11249); the provider never attaches interactively

engine:ContainerStart?detachKeys.skip: detach key sequence only matters to an interactive client attached to a TTY that types it (swagger.yaml:8970-8976, 11244-11249); the provider never attaches interactively
